name: Imouto Netori ~Mi mo Kokoro mo Onii-chan no Mono~
original_name: 妹寝取り～身も心もお兄ちゃんのモノ～
source:
I dozed in my futon waiting for Aoi to come. Nothing was quite as nice as being woken by my beloved little sister. She would knock on the door and turn the knob. I would hear her come in, and the sound of her voice would gently rouse me... is how it was supposed to go.

But Aoi didn't come into my room. Instead, from the door, she said,

"It's morning. Get up already."

How cold! Without a single footstep into my room she barked the words and shut the door.
I scrambled out of the futon but she'd already stomped off downstairs. What was with her lately?

We'd always gotten along. However, these days we barely even spoke. It's true I was working more often and she was coming into her own as a young woman, but... I still loved her as my little sister.
She seemed to be more irritable as she got more beautiful.

This spring she had started dating someone.

This is where I ought to take command of my little sister, right?
She wouldn't like it at first but it's for her own good. It's best to spare her the heartbreak of some dodgy other guy.

The question is how to achieve this.....
Then came a night where our parents went on a work holiday, and it was just Aoi and me. Alone in the house together, I can make her do whatever I say. I've got to undo what's taking over my little sister. It appears that their relationship has not yet progressed beyond holding hands, My sister can still be saved.

Now is the time to act on a chance.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE134347.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我在蒲团里打瞌睡，等待葵的到来。没有什么比被我心爱的小妹妹叫醒更美妙的了。她会敲门并转动旋钮。我会听到她进来，她的声音会轻轻地唤醒我……本来就是这样的。

但葵没有进我的房间。相反，她在门口说：

“早上了，快起来吧。”

多么冷啊！她没有走进我的房间，大声喊出这句话，然后关上了门。
我从蒲团里爬出来，但她已经跺脚下楼了。她最近怎么了？

我们一直相处得很好。然而，这些天我们几乎没有说话。确实，我工作的时间越来越多，她也逐渐成为一个年轻女性，但……我仍然像爱我的小妹妹一样爱她。
随着她变得越来越漂亮，她似乎也变得更加暴躁。

今年春天她开始和某人约会。

这就是我应该指挥妹妹的地方吧？
一开始她不喜欢，但这是为了她好。最好不要让她被其他狡猾的家伙伤心。

问题是如何实现这一目标……
然后有一天晚上，我们的父母去工作度假，只有葵和我。单独在家里，我可以让她按我说的做。我必须消除对我妹妹的影响。看来他们的关系还没有发展到牵手的地步，姐姐还有救。

现在是抓住机会采取行动的时候了。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE134347.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
